ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Corruption in Local Government
ideas.description: Investigate the financial records and contracts of Lancaster City Hall to identify potential corruption and wrongdoing
questions: What are the sources of funding for Lancaster City Hall?
Are there any irregularities in the city's financial records?
ideas.insight: By following the money and investigating the financial records of Lancaster City Hall, we may uncover evidence of corruption and wrongdoing. This story has the potential to expose significant wrongdoing and hold public officials accountable.
